title: One-step synthesis of 2-arylindoles from indolines via Pd-catalyzed oxidative dehydrogenation and C2-selective arylation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28131-28135
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04628A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yo-Sep Yang, Jiyeon Yoo, Juhyeon Jeon, Jun Hwi Bak, Jeong-Won Shin, Hyuck-Jae Won, Hee Sung Hwang, Ju Hee Kim, Jaehoon Sim, Nam-Jung Kim
We report an efficient synthetic approach to 2-arylindoles from indolines via a one-step process involving Pd-catalyzed oxidative dehydrogenation and a sequential C2-regioselective Heck-type reaction.
